The target video is a 10-second, three-shot sequence in 3D Chinese anime photorealistic photography style, with strong warm-cool light-and-shadow contrast, ultra-detailed visuals, and rich translucent fabric draping. The mood is quiet, intimate, and contemplative.
[Shot 1] A close-up opens on <Subject 1>, the young woman from <Picture 1> with long flowing black hair, fair skin, and red lips, lying on the bed with her eyes tightly closed, her hair spread softly across the bedding. She wears the pale cyan sheer hanfu with silver-grey cloud embroidery and white ribbon sash. <Subject 2>, the pale cyan gauze canopy embroidered with cloud patterns, drifts faintly around her, its translucent edges catching warm sunlight from the wooden lattice windows of <Subject 3>. The camera holds nearly static with a very subtle slow drift. The room is utterly quiet except for her faint, gentle breathing and a barely audible rustle of gauze. Cut at ~3s.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot: <Subject 1> slowly opens her grey-blue eyes and gazes around the sunlit room, her movements slow and full of contemplation. Sunlight and shadow play across the sheer canopy of <Subject 2>, its rich draping shifting gently as she stirs; the dark wooden table and ming-style chair of <Subject 3> sit softly in the background depth. The camera performs a slow, small push-in. Her faint breathing continues beneath the quiet room tone. Cut at ~6s.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to an intimate close-up of <Subject 1>'s face, held nearly static with minimal movement. Her lips part slightly, brows faintly drawn, and she softly whispers, her voice weak yet charged with emotional tension, <d>[Chinese] Hiss...</d> Warm light rims her face against cool shade, her red lips and pale skin rendered in ultra detail, the embroidered gauze of <Subject 2> softly blurred at the frame edge. The whispered breath fades into stillness as the shot holds to 10s.
